title: NSW Working with Children Check review: consultation summary report released
body: The Children's Guardian has released the Consultation Summary Report for the review of the NSW Working with Children Act. The consultation was held from November 2025 to March 2026 and thousands participated. The Office of the Children's Guardian will identify how to best update the Working with Children Check and share its advice with the NSW Government.
source: Office of the Children's Guardian NSW
verifiedQuote: The consultation, which was held from November 2025 to March 2026, was one of the largest consultations the Office of the Children's Guardian (OCG) has conducted, with thousands participating.
correction: The draft states 'thousands of people took part' but the source says 'thousands participating' which is correct, and states the Office will 'give its advice' when the source says advice 'will be shared' (future tense, not completed); these are minor but the main issue is the draft says 'The Office of the Children's Guardian will now work out' suggesting immediate future action when published October 2026, but the context shows this is already underway as 'the next step'.

title: Football Victoria publishes WWC Connect how-to guide for clubs
body: Football Victoria has a Working With Children Reform section on its child safety page, including a step-by-step 'How to use WWC Connect Guide' for club administrators and a link to the government webinar on the changes. The page states that all clubs must verify workers or volunteers in child related roles hold a valid Working with Children Check clearance via the WWC checker, and that clubs must also register their organisation through Services Victoria WWC Connect.
verifiedQuote: Football Victoria has developed a ' How to use WWC Connect Guide ' to assist club administrators with a step-by-step process. All clubs (organisations) must verify a worker or volunteer involved in child related roles via the WWC checker. Clubs must also register their organisation through Services Victoria WWC Connect.
correction: The source does not state that Football Victoria 'has added' a Working With Children Reform section (no timing is given), and does not use the phrase 'must register' but rather 'Clubs must also register' which appears in context of linking to the registration portal.

title: Vicsport online session on the new WWC Check changes for sport
body: Vicsport is running a free online Child Safe Sport Community of Practice on Monday 16 November 2026, 10:30am to 12:00pm, on the Working with Children Check changes that started on 19 October 2026. It will cover WWC Connect, the mandatory child safety training and how to put the changes into practice in sporting organisations, clubs and associations. Registrations close at 11:55pm on 15 November 2026.
verifiedQuote: Join VicSport for our next Child Safe Sport Community of Practice as we explore the recent changes to Victoria's Working with Children Check (WWCC) requirements, which came into effect on 19 October 2026.
